items.name: WhichCaptures
items.summary: A configuration indicating which kinds of [`State::Capture`](crate::nfa::thompson::State::Capture) states to include.

methods.name: is_any
methods.summary: Returns true if this configuration indicates that some capture states should be added to an NFA. Note that this might only include capture states for implicit capture groups.

methods.name: is_none
methods.summary: Returns true if this configuration indicates that no capture states should be produced in an NFA.

items.name: Compiler
items.summary: A builder for compiling an NFA from a regex's high-level intermediate representation (HIR).

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Compile the given regular expression pattern into an NFA.

methods.name: build_from_hir
methods.summary: Compile the given high level intermediate representation of a regular expression into an NFA.

methods.name: build_many
methods.signature: fn build_many<P: AsRef<str>>(&self, patterns: &[P]) -> Result<NFA, BuildError>
methods.summary: Compile the given regular expression patterns into a single NFA.

methods.name: build_many_from_hir
methods.signature: fn build_many_from_hir<H: Borrow<Hir>>(&self, exprs: &[H]) -> Result<NFA, BuildError>
methods.summary: Compile the given high level intermediate representations of regular expressions into a single NFA.

methods.name: configure
methods.signature: fn configure(&mut self, config: Config) -> &mut Compiler
methods.summary: Apply the given NFA configuration options to this builder.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new NFA builder with its default configuration.

methods.name: syntax
methods.signature: fn syntax(&mut self, config: util::syntax::Config) -> &mut Compiler
methods.summary: Set the syntax configuration for this builder using [`syntax::Config`](crate::util::syntax::Config).

items.name: Config
items.summary: The configuration used for a Thompson NFA compiler.

methods.name: captures
methods.summary: Whether to include 'Capture' states in the NFA.

methods.name: get_captures
methods.summary: Return whether NFA compilation is configured to produce capture states.

methods.name: get_look_matcher
methods.summary: Return the look-around matcher for this NFA.

methods.name: get_nfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Return the configured NFA size limit, if it exists, in the number of bytes of heap used.

methods.name: get_reverse
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled reverse NFA compilation.

methods.name: get_shrink
methods.summary: Return whether NFA shrinking is enabled.

methods.name: get_utf8
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled UTF-8 mode.

methods.name: get_which_captures
methods.summary: Return what kinds of capture states will be compiled into an NFA.

methods.name: look_matcher
methods.summary: Sets the look-around matcher that should be used with this NFA.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Return a new default Thompson NFA compiler configuration.

methods.name: nfa_size_limit
methods.summary: Sets an approximate size limit on the total heap used by the NFA being compiled.

methods.name: reverse
methods.summary: Reverse the NFA.

methods.name: shrink
methods.summary: Apply best effort heuristics to shrink the NFA at the expense of more time/memory.

methods.name: utf8
methods.summary: Whether to enable UTF-8 mode during search or not.

methods.name: which_captures
methods.summary: Configures what kinds of capture groups are compiled into [`State::Capture`](crate::nfa::thompson::State::Capture) states in a Thompson NFA.
